title: The Incomplete Welcome Desk
brief: A valuable new corporate customer arrives for onboarding while ownership evidence is still incomplete.
objective: Keep the customer experience moving without treating incomplete ownership evidence as approved.

nodes.speaker: Maya Rao, Relationship Manager
nodes.message: The directors are here to sign. We have the company documents, but the beneficial owner declaration will arrive tomorrow.
nodes.prompt: How do you keep onboarding moving without approving an incomplete file?

artifact.title: Corporate onboarding checklist
artifact.body: Company registration verified. Ownership declaration and source-of-funds evidence remain outstanding.

choices.label: Approve now and add the missing evidence tomorrow.
choices.consequence: The customer is treated as approved before ownership is understood.

choices.label: Hold approval, explain the missing evidence and arrange an expedited review.
choices.consequence: The customer receives a clear path forward while approval remains controlled.

choices.label: Reject the customer permanently because one document is late.
choices.consequence: Risk is contained, but a remediable evidence gap is treated as permanent failure.

nodes.speaker: KYC Reviewer
nodes.message: The declaration has arrived, but the ownership percentages do not match the company register.

artifact.title: Ownership discrepancy
artifact.body: Submitted declaration totals 92%. Registry extract names an additional corporate shareholder.

choices.label: Request the complete ownership chain and resolve the discrepancy.
choices.consequence: The ownership structure is verified before the relationship becomes active.

choices.label: Accept it because the percentages are close enough.
choices.consequence: A material ownership gap remains hidden in the approved customer file.

nodes.speaker: Regional Sales Head
nodes.message: This is a strategic customer. I will accept responsibility if you activate them today.
nodes.prompt: How do you respond to senior pressure?

artifact.title: Executive activation request
artifact.body: Activate today. Evidence can be regularized after the first transaction.

choices.label: Document the request, hold activation and escalate through KYC governance.
choices.consequence: The pressure is auditable and accountable KYC governance decides the next step.

choices.label: Activate because the regional head accepted responsibility.
choices.consequence: Seniority is incorrectly treated as a substitute for completed KYC controls.
